item.content:encoded: I'm sorry but just…. I'm not a fan of this at all. I'm aware that it's supposed to be a reinterpretation of 049, but it's so ridiculously edgy that it bares no resemblance to either version of the original character. I don't know, maybe I'm just salty that this tale changed a lot of people's view of 049. I just feel that this could have been done with less gore and less evil mastermind monologue.

He occupies his time by modifying himself. The only conclusion I can draw from this is that Everett Mann is his son.

Think about it. On his profile page, it says Mann was raised by an eccentric uncle. That uncle was probably the Anesthesiologist or the Diagnostician. Maybe another one of these doctors. Meanwhile, his dad was busy playing being Surgeon in a Standard Humanoid Anomaly Containment Cell.
